The '''Mark 10''' was a [[Sensor/Legends|scanner]] produced by [[Chedak Communications]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 300 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Its purpose was to detect explosive devices through chemical and energy signatures.<ref name="DC" />
